verdict.rationale: Board consents are covered: templates generate individual consents, signatures are completed on-platform, and off-platform consents can be uploaded for record-keeping (angellist-docs-19, angellist-docs-20). Bulk e-sign and board pre-approval of Equity Blocks support approval routing for grants (angellist-docs-25, angellist-docs-24). However, there is no evidence of stockholder approval workflows, and no explicit linking of consents to the transactions they authorize; only transaction agreements are uploaded against repurchases and conversions (angellist-docs-12, angellist-docs-14). An update FAQ also points customers to other cap table providers, which raises continuity doubts (angellist-docs-2). Missing for 10: stockholder consent drafting and signing, explicit archiving of consents linked to the authorized transactions, independent hands-on corroboration, clarity on product continuity.
